decisions.reason: As a low-cost accessory that remained listed in 2018 and 2019, it likely did not fall clearly below aspiration levels and is cheap for a medium established firm to carry.
A box car trailer series is close to the firm's core business, and its home-page presence in both years suggests satisfactory early performance relative to aspirations.

The car transporter trailer fits the firm's capabilities but serves a narrower niche, so it is somewhat more vulnerable if results were only borderline, though two years of visibility support keeping it.
The low-bed trailer series is a core product-category extension with repeated prominent display, which points to acceptable performance and enough slack to continue it.
The high trailer cover series complements the firm's trailer range and after-sales logic, so unless it clearly underperformed, management would likely retain it.
This second box car trailer series also sits in the firm's core market, and while overlap raises some rationalisation risk, its continued promotion suggests performance near or above aspiration.
